title: Correcting a Reason: No es que… sino que…
goal: Reject a reason with no es que and the subjunctive, and give the real reason with sino que and the indicative.

items: I can reject a reason with no es que and the subjunctive.
I can give the real reason with sino que and the indicative.
I can use the new words for reasons and complaints.
